title: SMS gateway with a JSON HTTP API
ported_from: a production SMS gateway channel (bounded fetch, status mapping), generalized to any JSON gateway
usage: createOtp({ environment: 'prod', provider: 'code', store, secret, channel: new HttpSmsChannel({ url, apiKey, sender, render: (m) => `Your code is ${m.code}` }) });
notes: Keys only. The gateway must accept POST JSON { to, from, text } with a bearer key and answer JSON with an `id` (or `messageId`).
